snippet.title: Mega Man: Dual Override - 2nd Trailer - Proto Man Gameplay
snippet.description:
Proto Man returns as a playable character, joining his brother in Mega Man: Dual Override! Witness some of Proto Man's unique abilities in the latest trailer, including Custom Chips, close combat techniques, and a powerful Override to overwhelm enemies.
 
Mega Man: Dual Override will launch on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, XBOX on PC, Steam and Epic Games Store in Spring 2027. Stay tuned for more updates!

Official Website: 
https://www.capcom-games.com/megaman/do/

Mega Man X Account: 
https://x.com/MegaMan
